name: collagen type I alpha 2 chain

function.text: COL1A2 encodes collagen alpha-2(I) chain. Annotated molecular activities include protein-macromolecule adaptor activity and extracellular matrix structural constituent. It participates in Rho protein signal transduction and odontogenesis.

germline.text: Retained constitutional disease associations include COL1A2-related Ehlers-Danlos syndrome (autosomal dominant); COL1A2-related osteogenesis imperfecta (autosomal dominant). Pathogenicity and inheritance depend on the specific allele and disorder.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include ALK-positive histiocytosis. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
